privacy.intro: PAM is built for people who have good reason to be careful. Here is what we keep, who can see it, and what we will never do.
privacy.s.contact.p1: If something here worries you, call us. A person answers.
privacy.s.contact.p2: PAM is run by Oba, a company in Philadelphia.
privacy.s.contact.title: Talk to a person
privacy.s.how-long.p1: We keep your account while you use PAM. Ask us to delete it and we will.
privacy.s.how-long.p2: Some records stay for a while so a program can prove you attended. We keep as little as we can, for as short a time as we can.
privacy.s.how-long.title: How long we keep it
privacy.s.never-say.p1: A text lands on a screen other people can read. So our messages never say why you use PAM, never name your program, and never say anything about your record.
privacy.s.never-say.p2: This is not a promise we ask you to trust. It is checked by tests every time we change the app.
privacy.s.never-say.title: What a text will never say
privacy.s.sharing.p1: We do not sell it. We do not trade it. We do not run ads.
privacy.s.sharing.p2: A program sees you only after you sign up with them, and only what they need to help you.
privacy.s.sharing.p3: We use other companies to run PAM, like the one that sends our texts. They handle your information for us and may not use it for anything else.
privacy.s.sharing.title: Who else gets your information
privacy.s.texts.p1: We text you a code when you sign in. Later we may text reminders and updates about your account.
privacy.s.texts.p2: Reply STOP any time and the texts stop. Nothing in the app can turn them back on.
privacy.s.texts.p3: Your phone company may charge you for texts. That is between you and them.
privacy.s.texts.title: Text messages
privacy.s.what-we-keep.p1: Your first name, your phone number, and the language you pick.
privacy.s.what-we-keep.p2: What you sign up for, the visits you plan, whether you went, and the points you earn.
privacy.s.what-we-keep.p3: The messages you send in PAM. We keep them so you can read them later.
privacy.s.what-we-keep.title: What we keep
privacy.s.who-can-see.p1: The person who invited you can see what you are working on, the programs you joined, your visits, your points, the last day you used PAM, who you connect with, and that a chat exists.
privacy.s.who-can-see.p2: They cannot read your messages. They cannot see what you share with your buddies. They cannot see people who are not on their list.
privacy.s.who-can-see.p3: They see one of your messages only if someone reports it as not safe. Then they see that message, and nothing else from the chat.
privacy.s.who-can-see.p4: This is the same list we show you when you join. If it ever changes, we will tell you first.
privacy.s.who-can-see.title: Who can see it
privacy.s.your-choices.p1: Stop the texts by replying STOP.
privacy.s.your-choices.p2: Ask us for a copy of what we keep about you, or ask us to delete it.
privacy.s.your-choices.p3: Block someone, or report a message that is not safe. Both work from inside the chat.
privacy.s.your-choices.title: What you can do
privacy.title: Privacy
reminders.how: A few messages a week at most. Reply STOP any time and they stop for good. Reply HELP to reach a person. Text and data rates may apply.

terms.intro: The deal between you and PAM, in plain words. Using PAM means you agree to this.
terms.s.being-decent.p1: Do not threaten, harass, or lie to people here.
terms.s.being-decent.p2: If a message is not safe, report it. A person reads it.
terms.s.being-decent.p3: You can block anyone, and they will not know.
terms.s.being-decent.title: Being decent to each other
terms.s.changes.p1: We may change these terms. If the change matters, we will tell you in the app.
terms.s.changes.p2: Keep using PAM and the new terms apply.
terms.s.changes.title: Changes
terms.s.emergencies.p1: If you are in danger or someone is hurt, call 911.
terms.s.emergencies.p2: If you are in crisis, call or text 988. Someone answers day and night.
terms.s.emergencies.title: PAM is not for emergencies
terms.s.limits.p1: We can turn off parts of PAM for an account that is hurting other people.
terms.s.limits.p2: Messages are never turned off. Anyone can always reach for help.
terms.s.limits.p3: When something is turned off, PAM tells you it is off and who to call.
terms.s.limits.title: When we limit an account
terms.s.points.p1: Points show what you have done. They are not money and cannot be cashed out.
terms.s.points.p2: If we ever offer real rewards, we will say so first.
terms.s.points.title: Points
terms.s.programs.p1: We get our list from the city and from the programs themselves. Hours change and places close.
terms.s.programs.p2: Call ahead when you can. If a place is wrong or closed, flag it and we will check.
terms.s.programs.p3: What happens at a program is between you and them. We cannot promise a spot or a result.
terms.s.programs.title: Programs and places
terms.s.what-pam-is.p1: PAM helps you find places and people that can help, and keeps track of what you plan to do.
terms.s.what-pam-is.p2: PAM does not run the programs it lists. Other organisations do.
terms.s.what-pam-is.title: What PAM is
terms.s.your-account.p1: You sign in with your phone number. There is no password to lose.
terms.s.your-account.p2: Keep your account to yourself. Anyone holding your phone can get in.
terms.s.your-account.p3: Tell us if you get a new number, so your reminders follow you.
terms.s.your-account.title: Your account
terms.title: Terms of service
